title: Projection transport across the normalized proper/open comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, Operations o and a RealizationModel model [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], an arbitrary scheme morphism f:X→Y with compactification c, an integral derived object K on X, a proof hunit that the actual reconstruction unit at ringedOpen(c.i)(K) is invertible, and n∈N. Compose model.push at the open reduction system with proper image of the limit of model.openReduction followed by the inverse actual reconstruction unit. Composing this integral morphism with the scalar-adjunction transpose of the finite geometric proper/open reduction comparison (in finiteReductionIso/finiteImageIso coordinates) equals the actual coefficientSequenceProjection followed by restricted supportEvaluation and compact support of reductionEvaluation. This is an equality of integral derived arrows to the restricted finite compact-support value. It asserts no tower comparison, integral realization isomorphism, or constructibility.

source.place: Primitive tensor reassociation, evaluation and adjunction unit/counit comparisons; agent-formulated component of lem-sf-integral-basic-realization.

proof.text: Factor the normalized finite compact-support comparison as properFiniteReduction followed by finite proper image of openFiniteReduction, using comparison_factorization, naturality of finiteDirectImage_eq and cancellation of finiteReductionIso at the intermediate scheme. This is support_finite_factorization in the Lean proof.

For r=model.openReduction at K and h=L(r) followed by the inverse reconstruction unit, the left-adjunction triangle and counit naturality show F(h)=μ(M) followed by evaluation of r and reductionEvaluation at the open output. Compose this equality with integralOpenFiniteEvaluation. Naturality of properFiniteReduction and integralProperFiniteProjection now paste the proper and open equations. Expand supportEvaluation to identify the two finite factors. Finally counit_projection and naturality of the scalar homEquiv transpose this finite equality into the required integral projection equation.

theorem integralSupportProjectionTransport (o : Operations l E)
    (model : RealizationModel l E o)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (K : Integral l E X)
    (hunit : IsIso ((calculus l E c.Z).adjunction.unit.app ((ringedOpen l E c.i).obj K)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (model.push l E c.g).hom.app
        ((Operations.shriek l E o c.i).obj ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K)) ≫
      (ringedPush l E c.g).map
        ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E c.Z).map ((model.openReduction l E c.i).app K) ≫
          @inv _ _ _ _ ((calculus l E c.Z).adjunction.unit.app
            ((ringedOpen l E c.i).obj K)) hunit) ≫
      ((derivedScalarExtensionRestrictionAdjunction l E Y n).choose.homEquiv _ _)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finiteReductionIso l E Y n).inv.app
            ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) c).obj K) ≫
          (PurCompactSupport.comparison
            (PurCompactSupport.reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) c).app K ≫
          (PurCompactSupport.finiteImageIso l E n c).hom.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend
              (PurCompactSupport.projection l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) X)).obj K) ≫
          (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).map
              ((PurCompactSupport.finiteReductionIso l E X n).hom.app K)) =
      (coefficientSequenceProjection l E Y n).app
          ((Operations.push l E o c.g).obj
            ((Operations.shriek l E o c.i).obj ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K))) ≫
        (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n).map
          ((supportEvaluation l E o c n).hom.app ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K) ≫
            (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).map
                (((calculus l E X).reductionEvaluation n).hom.app K))
